chunks: And by this chain, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
“Say: By the grace of Allah and by His mercy—so by that let them rejoice; it is better than what they amass.”
He عليه السلام said: “By the wilayah of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the family of Muḥammad عليهم السلام. It is better than what these people amass from their worldly life.”

key_terms.بِوَلَايَةِ: through the wilayah, authority and devotion owed

ai.seo_question: What does Qur'an 10:58 mean according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام in relation to the wilayah of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an interpretation of the verse as referring to rejoicing in the wilayah of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عليهم السلام. It teaches that this divine grace and mercy are superior to worldly accumulations and material gain.
